speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing sudden-onset lower back pain that radiates down your leg. To determine the cause, can you tell me how severe the pain is on a scale of 1 to 10, and does it affect your ability to walk or stand?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Herniated Disc (likely L5-S1).

I have enough clinical information from your history of sudden onset pain after exercise radiating to the foot to make this diagnosis; do you experience any weakness in your foot or numbness in the groin area? REQUEST IMAGES: Lumbar_Spine_MRI
